lines.t: I spent a lifetime chasing shadows down the hall
Building up my kingdom just to watch the curtain fall
I was leaning on a broken reed, drifting in the gray
Counting every second just to throw the hours away
Yeah, I was drowning in the static, lost inside the noise
Trading my inheritance for temporary joys The clock was ticking but I wasn't moving
I had a debt that I was never proving And the light broke through the dark

You're the only path, you're the only one I follow
